cover-docs.title: The Adaptive Convexity Framework
cover-docs.description: A tax-aware method for compounding through unstable markets: six Parts, from philosophy to scoring, free to read.

part-2-lineage-macro.title: Part 2 · Lineage & Macro Thesis · The Adaptive Convexity Framework

part-6-convexity-scoring.title: Part 6 · Convexity & Framework Integrity Scoring · The Adaptive Convexity Framework
part-6-convexity-scoring.description: CIS rates each position, FIS rates how the portfolio is put together, and a weekly routine acts on both.

glossary.title: Glossary · The Adaptive Convexity Framework

framework-in-math.description: The formulas behind CIS and FIS, how a score becomes a position size, and what governance does and does not do.
